name: homelab
initializeCommand: bash -c 'if [ -d ~/.claude ]; then mkdir -p .devcontainer/.claude-tmp && cp -r ~/.claude/* .devcontainer/.claude-tmp/ 2>/dev/null || true; fi'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'if [ -d /workspaces/homelab/.devcontainer/.claude-tmp ]; then mkdir -p ~/.claude && cp -r /workspaces/homelab/.devcontainer/.claude-tmp/* ~/.claude/ && sed -i "s|localhost:6655|host.docker.internal:6655|g" ~/.claude/settings.json && echo "✓ Claude Code configured with proxy at host.docker.internal:6655"; else echo "ℹ Claude Code not configured (optional - only for users with Claude Code installed)"; fi'
